turns.question: What was the 90th percentile order amount in EUR for all orders placed between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no percentile of order amount (a median order value exists only for BigQuery and is not available here). The closest metrics are average_order_value_eur (Average order value, non-cancelled orders), revenue_eur and orders_total; I can give one of those for 17 August to 2 October 2026 if you want.
